summary: Strategic council deliberation on ghostwriting ICP positioning. Four council agents (Revenue Realist, Alignment Purist, Market Physicist, Pattern Diagnostician) deliberated across 3 rounds on whether to target S&C coaches or B2B founders/fintech for LinkedIn ghostwriting. Unanimous recommendation: commit fully to B2B founders/fintech, with a $7,500 MRR revenue gate to return to S&C coaches. Includes concrete next steps, messaging pivots, minority report, and decision checkpoints.
